# Ajit Singh Rathore (ASRBMY)

> Student from Rajasthan, India, working in cyber security, ethical hacking, OSINT, applied AI and robotics. Online handle: ASRBMY. National runner-up (2nd position) and Best Team Award winner at the AI VidyaSetu hackathon (Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan).
